tuitionNonEU: Italian state conservatoires charge a 'contributo onnicomprensivo annuale' banded by ISEE, from €0 (no-tax area) up to a top band typically in the €1,000–€1,700 range depending on the institution's regolamento tasse. EXACT FIGURES PER INSTITUTION WERE NOT VERIFIED IN THIS SWEEP.

scholarshipName: Borsa di studio DSU (regional right-to-study grant)
scholarships: CONFIRMED that AFAM students (conservatoires included) are eligible for the regional DSU borsa di studio — the Lazio DISCO and DSU Toscana 2026/27 bandi both cover AFAM institutions. The 2026/27 national minimum amounts are approximately €2,850 (in sede) rising to about €7,072–€7,171 for a 'fuori sede' student — the figure quoted in the brief (€7,171.11) is consistent with the 2026/27 MUR minimum, but I could NOT locate the exact decree line confirming that precise number; treat the exact cent value as UNVERIFIED. Non-EU students ARE eligible in principle. Two hard practical constraints found: (1) 'fuori sede' status is only recognised if the student registers a genuine, Agenzia delle Entrate-registered tenancy contract by the bando deadline (Lazio DISCO 2026/27 sets that at 27 December 2026 for that cycle) — so a late-arriving student can lose the highest band; (2) a student resident abroad CANNOT file an ordinary ISEE and must instead obtain an 'ISEE parificato', which requires income and property documentation from the home country, translated and legalised by the Italian diplomatic authorities there. THIS CONFIRMS THE WRINKLE IN THE BRIEF: without an ISEE/ISEE parificato in hand at enrolment the student is placed in the TOP fee band for year one, dropping only once the parificato is filed. The ISEE parificato can in fact be obtained from abroad through a CAF before arrival, which is the practical workaround — but it needs consular legalisation and should be started months ahead.
deadline: DSU bandi typically open in July and close in late August/September for the following academic year. Lazio DISCO published its 2026/27 bando in June–July 2026.

program: DCSL61 Tecnico del Suono / DCSL60 Musica Applicata across all 76 public conservatori
qualification: Diploma Accademico di Secondo Livello (biennio, 120 CFU)
accreditationStatus: METHOD: the full list of Italian public conservatoires was taken from the MUR register (mur.gov.it/it/aree-tematiche/afam/gli-istituti/conservatori-di-musica-pubblici) and each institution's site was machine-crawled (sitemaps plus two-level link crawl of didattica/corsi paths) for DCSL61, DCSL60, 'tecnico del suono', 'musica applicata', 'produzione musicale', 'ingegneria del suono'. NO SINGLE MUR OR AFAM PAGE LISTING EVERY INSTITUTION OFFERING DCSL61 EXISTS. The MUR portal valutazioni-afam.mur.gov.it/gestione-decreti-off/ publishes ONLY newly created and newly modified courses per year, not the standing catalogue — I checked the 2026-27 biennio decree lists for all eight institution types and they contain only a handful of institutions (Reggio Calabria, Avellino, Matera, Benevento, Torino, Cuneo, Teramo for NEW bienni; Castelfranco Veneto, L'Aquila, Parma, Avellino, Monopoli, Roma, Frosinone, Siena, Modena e Carpi for MODIFIED bienni). So institution-by-institution checking is unavoidable.
englishTeaching: NEGATIVE FINDING ACROSS THE WHOLE ITALIAN CONSERVATOIRE SYSTEM: not one of the sound/production bienni found in this sweep publishes any English-taught delivery. English pages exist only for Erasmus incoming students. Italian at roughly B2 is the practical requirement everywhere.
whatYouStudy: Not applicable — coverage record.
entryRequirements: Not applicable
acceptsNonMusic: SYSTEM-LEVEL OBSERVATION: the AFAM statutory formula, quoted verbatim from Rovigo, is 'in possesso di diploma accademico di primo livello, o di diploma di laurea triennale, o di diploma di conservatorio di previgente ordinamento congiunto ad un diploma di scuola secondaria superiore' — 'diploma di laurea triennale' carries NO subject restriction, so a BSc in Software Engineering satisfies the paper requirement almost everywhere. The real filter is always the esame di ammissione, not the degree subject.

scholarships: NEGATIVE FINDINGS — conservatoires confirmed to have NO second-level sound/production course: Cagliari (Tecnico del suono is I livello only), Novara (I livello only), Bergamo/Politecnico delle Arti (DCPL61 triennio only, 180 CFU, confirmed verbatim 'Diploma Accademico di I livello'), Pavia (DCPL61 triennio only, 180 CFU, confirmed), Cesena-Rimini (propedeutico and triennio only), Ferrara (triennio admission programme only), Cosenza (its published DCSL list runs DCSL01–DCSL66 with NO DCSL61; only DCSL34 Musica elettronica), Bari (Tecnico del suono I livello; II livello is DCSL34 Musica elettronica), Firenze (Musica Applicata is I livello; II livello is DCSL34 Musica elettronica), Bologna (no Tecnico del suono; only Musica applicata ind. Musica per film), Mantova (I livello), Trapani's Musica Applicata (DCPL60, I livello only — its Tecnico del suono however IS available at II livello).
